notes.title: Demo Patch Note v 0.1.4.2
notes.notes:
Bug fixes

Fixed a bug that made visuals disappear after a while

Changes

For characters without armor, the armor bar is now not displayed
Dread Fiend's walking sounds have been changed

notes.title: Riftborn Demo Patch Note v 0.1.4.1
notes.notes:
Balance changes

Increased Dread Fiend block damage reduction (from 20% to 70%)

Bug FIxes

All characters in the game are now covered in blood, not just the knight
The link to the discord server in the main menu has been changed to a working one
Fixed stuck places on the map
Fixed a bug where dash was automatically pressed
Fixed a bug where pickups were not displayed over time

notes.title: Riftborn Demo Patch Note - 0.1.3.0
notes.notes:
Balance update 0.1.3.0
Bug fixes

 Fixed a bug that caused the screen to change saturation too early depending on health amount
 Fixed a bug that caused chat to appear immediately after respawning
 Fixed a bug that caused parries to start instantly

Changes

 Now, if your attack/block button is held down, the character will start attacking/blocking as soon as possible (after stanning, parrying, etc.)
 The block now reduces some of the incoming damage and does not expire after the first blocked attack
 If you are sparred, you will lose stamina.
 If you fall into the lava, but you took damage before that, the kill counts for the last person who dealt damage to you
 When the attack power is fully charged, your sword will glow and players will hear a distinctive sound
 If your stamina is not enough to perform a jump/jump/sprint, the game will notify you with a sound and flashing stamina bar
 Every character now has a passive health regeneration effect

Misc

 After picking up health bonus, the arrows in your body disappear
 By default, the second style of music is now played
 The “Details” options have become two additional graphics settings
 If you have blocked/sparred, the game will notify you with an indicator 
 The server notifies players in chat if someone has joined or left the server

Graphics

 The map is brighter now
 Light has become static baked, because of which a performance boost and shadow visibility at low settings is expected
 Map textures became a little darker and more saturated

notes.title: Riftborn Demo Patch Note - 0.1.2.8
notes.notes:
Pickups now appear on clients when logged in to the server
 Pickups can now be picked up immediately
 Fake characters fixed
 Map became brighter
 Added more lighting (torches) to the map
 Stones on the map became lower, now easier to jump on
